ruleDefinitions.name: Legitimate Application Dropped Executable
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects programs on a Windows system that should not write executables to disk

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\eqnedt32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wordpad\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wordview\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\certutil\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\certoc\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\CertReq\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\Desktopimgdownldr\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\esentutl\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\AcroRd32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\RdrCEF\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\hh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\finger\\\.exe$")) AND (file_path = RGX("\\\.exe$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.dll$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.ocx$")))
